visitors.quote: Field studies revealed that Xylocopa species, particularly X. valga, X. violacea, X. iris and X. olivieri are valuable pollinators of some cultivated plants, such as ... sunflower (Helianthus annuus L.), and Canthamus tinctorius L. | Additionally, X. valga, X. violacea, X. iris and X. olivieri visit sunflower (Helianthus annuus L.) and safflower (Canthamus tinctorius L.), which are commonly cultivated plants in the family Compositae in the country.
